      INVALIDATE_ANIMATION "clip_fast"

      INVALIDATE_ANIMATION "clip_medfast"
    ELSEIF expression_mode=1 {op=46 TIMER value_payload=3 mode_payload=50 operand_tags=[0x2,0x2]}
      INVALIDATE_ANIMATION "clip_med"
    ELSEIF expression_mode=1 {op=46 TIMER value_payload=3 mode_payload=75 operand_tags=[0x2,0x2]}
      INVALIDATE_ANIMATION "clip_slow"
    ELSE
      INVALIDATE_ANIMATION "clip_realslow"

    CALL_SEQUENCE "clip_medfast"

    ELSE  ; opcode_flags=0x200

      OBJECT_MOTION  ; raw_args: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 33 33 b3 3e 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 02 16 00 00 1c 01 00 00  ; opcode_flags=0x200
